duration.quote: Six years' full-time experience under the supervision of a licensed master electrician; or b. Eight thousand hours of full-time experience under the supervision of a licensed master electrician, plus 576 hours of related instruction

exams.name: Written, standardized examination for licensure
exams.notes: Required for master electrician, master electrician special, journeyperson electrician, limited electrician, and limited electrician special. Passing score determined by Board in rules and regulations, approved by the Division. Not required for journeyperson applicants who completed a Board-approved apprenticeship program with a final exam.

exams.quote: a person applying for licensure as a master electrician, master electrician special, journeyperson electrician, limited electrician, and limited electrician special shall have achieved the passing score on the written, standardized examination for licensure, with a passing score as determined by the Board in rules and regulations, and which is approved by the Division.

available.quote: the Board shall grant a license to each applicant, who shall present proof of current licensure in "good standing" in another state, the District of Columbia or territory of the United States, whose standards for licensure are substantially similar to those of this State.

requirements.value: Applicant must present proof of current licensure in good standing in another state, DC, or US territory with substantially similar standards. If standards are not substantially similar, applicant must have practiced for at least 5 years after licensure.
requirements.quote: An applicant, who is licensed in a state whose standards are not substantially similar to those of this State, shall have practiced for a minimum of 5 years after licensure

definition_quote.value: Master electrician means a person, licensed by the Board, to plan, estimate, layout, perform or supervise the installation, erection or repair of any electrical conductor, molding, duct, raceway, conduit, machinery, apparatus, device or fixture for the purpose of lighting, heating or power in any structure.
definition_quote.quote: "Master electrician" means a person, licensed by the Board, to plan, estimate, layout, perform or supervise the installation, erection or repair of any electrical conductor, molding, duct, raceway, conduit, machinery, apparatus, device or fixture for the purpose of lighting, heating or power in any structure.

methods_authorized.quote: to plan, estimate, layout, perform or supervise the installation, erection or repair of any electrical conductor, molding, duct, raceway, conduit, machinery, apparatus, device or fixture

license_tiers.quote: Evaluate the credentials of all persons applying for a license as limited electrician, limited electrician special, master electrician, master electrician special, journeyperson electrician, apprentice electrician, and school apprentice electrician in this State

residential_project_definition.value: Electrical work performed on or within a residential dwelling or building, or work to or beyond the breaker panel or fuse box in a residential dwelling or building.
residential_project_definition.quote: Electricians with a residential electrician license are prohibited from performing any electrical work other than: (1) Electrical work performed on or within a residential dwelling or building prior to the dwelling or building being connected to the electric grid, or (2) Work to or beyond the breaker panel or fuse box in a residential dwelling or building.

value: Electrical work by electrical engineers/technicians in manufacturing or industrial facilities or laboratory/R&D settings
Department of Transportation work on drawbridges and traffic-control devices
Work beyond main breaker or fuse of 200 amps or less on structures used exclusively for agricultural purposes

Work by electric light or power companies, electric railway, steam railway, diesel railway, telegraph or telephone company, water or wastewater utility regulated by the Delaware Public Service Commission
Homeowner work on their own home under a homeowner's permit
Servicing equipment in heating, air conditioning, refrigeration or appliances
scope_exclusions.quote: Nothing in this title shall be construed to prevent the performing of electrical work by: (1) Any of the following individuals working in a manufacturing or industrial facility ... (2) The Department of Transportation ... (3) Persons working beyond the main breaker or fuse of 200 amps or less on structures used exclusively for agricultural purposes ... (4) Any electric light or power company ... (5) Any homeowner or homeowners who comply with the mandates of § 1417 of this title.

minor_electrical_work_amperage_limit.quote: Persons working beyond the main breaker or fuse of 200 amps or less on structures used exclusively for agricultural purposes

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: If a partnership, firm or corporation suffers a loss of a license holder, the partnership, firm or corporation shall notify the Board in writing with supporting documentation within 7 days of the loss of a license holder.
qualifier_replacement_notice_days.citation: § 1418. Partnership, firm or corporation; loss of license holder.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: The Board shall schedule an emergency meeting within 10 days during which time the partnership, firm or corporation may continue to operate without a license holder
qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.citation: § 1418. Partnership, firm or corporation; loss of license holder.

journeyman_electrician_apprenticeship_ho.quote: Have over 8,000 hours of full-time experience performing electrical work under the supervision of a licensed master electrician, master electrician special, limited electrician or limited electrician special.
journeyman_electrician_apprenticeship_ho.citation: § 1408. Qualifications of applicant [For application of this section, see 81 Del. Laws, c. 290, § 5] [Effective until July 1, 2026].

utility_worker_exemption.quote: Any electric light or power company, electric railway company, steam railway company, diesel railway company, telegraph or telephone company, water or wastewater utility whose rates and services are regulated by the Delaware Public Service Commission, or any person performing the electrical work of such company or utility, when such work is a part of the plant or services used by the company in rendering its authorized service to the public

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: submits proof of general liability insurance as required by the Board.
public_liability_insurance_required.citation: § 1411. Issuance and renewal of licenses [Effective until July 1, 2026].
